title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Academic Speaking Test 3
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 3 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. When you go shopping, do you prefer to pay for things in cash or by card? [Why?]
2. Do you ever save money to buy special things? [Why/why not?]
3. Would you ever take a job which had low pay? [Why/why not?]
4. Would winning a lot of money make a big difference to your life? [Why/why not?]

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe an interesting discussion you had as part of your work or studies.
You should say:
• What the subject of the discussion was
• Who you discussed the subject with
• What opinions were expressed
And explain why you found the discussion interesting.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. Why is it good to discuss problems with other people?
2. Do you think that it's better to talk to friends and not family about problems?
3. Is it always a good idea to tell lots of people about a problem?
4. Which communication skills are most important when taking part in meetings with colleagues?
5. What are the possible effects of poor written communication skills at work?
6. What do you think will be the future impact of technology on communication in the workplace?
